description: This script is a Python tool for managing code coverage collection and reporting on Android devices, including functions for cleaning, flushing, and generating coverage reports using llvm tools and adb commands.

methods.name: android_build_top
methods.description: Returns the Path object for the ANDROID_BUILD_TOP environment variable.

methods.name: _get_clang_revision
methods.description: Retrieves the Clang version by executing a script and returns it as a string.

methods.name: check_output
methods.description: Wrapper around subprocess.check_output with added logging.

methods.name: adb
methods.description: Runs an adb command with logging.

methods.name: adb_shell
methods.description: Runs an 'adb shell' command with logging.

methods.name: send_flush_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to flush coverage data for specified or all processes.

methods.name: do_clean_device
methods.description: Resets coverage data on the device, including flushing and deleting raw coverage files.

methods.name: do_flush
methods.description: Flushes coverage data for specified or all processes on the device.

methods.name: do_report
methods.description: Pulls coverage data from the device, merges it, and generates an HTML report.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the script.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that executes functions based on parsed arguments.
